[[The Bog Beast of Bokku (NPC)|The Bog Beast of Bokku]] is a man-eating [[Plant]] that resides in [[Haiju Lagoon]].  It has a taste for naughty children.  It is said to appear again and again year after year.

== Locations ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Haiju Lagoon}} (on [[Teipao Island]], only during the following [[quest]])

== Quests ==
* Shing Jea Island
** [[The Bog Beast of Bokku]]

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Enfeebling Touch}}
* {{skill icon|Rising Bile}}
* {{skill icon|Rotting Flesh}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Enchanted Vine]]
* [[Spiritwood Plank]]

== Notes ==
* The Bog Beast of Bokku resembles a [[Thorn Wolf]].

== Trivia ==
* [[Headmaster Vhang]] claims to have killed the beast before.
* Possibly a reference to the [[w:List of races and species in The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy#Ravenous Bugblatter Beast of Traal|Ravenous Bugblatter Beast of Traal]] from ''[[w:The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy|The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy]]'' books by [[w:Douglas Adams|Douglas Adams]].
